title: Order task declarations by lifecycle
summary: Place task state first, then start, message handlers, and terminate so readers encounter the lifecycle in execution order.
recommendation: Declare all state fields before start, place start before ordinary message handlers, and place terminate after every ordinary handler.
rationale: A consistent lifecycle order makes task invariants, initialization, available messages, and cleanup visible without searching through the declaration.

lint_rule.source_text:
use language (
  version is v0.1,
  features is ( lint )
)
# Demonstrates a contained Topal-authored lint rule. The host supplies adjacent
# read-only task declaration phases as Int values; true preserves their order.
rule is fn static (previous : Int, current : Int) -> Boolean
  previous <= current
